Hello community,

We have historically had a Java community call to discuss ILP on the Java platform. This call hasn’t really happened lately, but I’m going to bring it back – the calls will be every-other Wednesday starting this week (so as not to collide with the regular ILP community call).

To clarify, the first call will be this Wednesday, August 28th, at 7am PST. The agenda is below, but feel free to suggest anything you’d like. The first few calls will be focused on Hyperledger Quilt tasks, expanding from there.

Agenda

  1. Introductions
  2. Discuss timing of the call.
  3. Discuss Quilt Roadmap
  4. Discuss open Quilt issues & PRs
  5. Q&A, misc issues
